en.why: The scroll starts almost still, so viewers can read the first words, then accelerates to about 8,200 px/s with horizontal blur that grows with speed. They read first and are then left behind, which shows how long the input is. Holding the last m and zooming into it fills the frame with repeated shapes and sets the beat of the film. The squeeze and the bloom happen at the same spot, frame center: the zoomed frame squeezes into a bar whose width, height and color match the bubble's starting bar, and the bubble opens from it evenly to both sides, so the eye does not move. The result sits next to the input: the counter stops at 36 words and the line under the bubble says 36 words to 10. One accent color (violet #5b3df5) is shared by the bubble, the mic, the badge and the mark.
spec: Film 11s. Scroll 0.1–3.2s (3.1s, 93 frames); brake 3.2–3.7s; held m 3.3–4.1s (0.8s, 26 extra m); zoom-in 3.45–4.4s (0.95s); squeeze 4.6–5.05s (0.45s, about 14 frames); bubble bloom 5.05–5.75s (0.7s); summary words 5.3–6.3s; camera pull-back 6.3–8.0s (1.7s, 51 frames); reply bubble 7.6s; window drift 8.0–8.9s (0.9s); window fades 8.65–8.9s; lockup lands at 8.9s and holds to the end (2.1s)
Scroll power2.in (cubic ease-in); brake and bloom expo.out; zoom-in and pull-back interpolate scale in log space (outQuart and outQuint curves); squeeze power3.inOut; summary words expo.out

One 120px line (Inter 500, letter-spacing -0.035em), 36 words, 9,833px wide, starting at x=160 and ending with "um" parked at x=930, next to frame center; horizontal blur stdDeviation 0 to 36px with speed, back to 0 within 0.5s of the brake; zoom-in 1x to 6.8x about frame center, so each m hump is about 446px tall (41% of the frame height) and only 2 to 3 m's stay in view; the 140px side fades go to 0 over 3.5–3.95s (0.45s, power2.inOut), so an m cut by the frame edge reads as part of an m; the squeeze treats the zoomed frame as one flat image, clipped to the 446px band the m's occupy so no blurred glyph tops show above the bar, and scales it on X about frame center from 1 to 0.0075, a bar about 14px wide and 446px tall, while its color turns from ink to violet (4.78–5.03s) and the horizontal blur rises to 14px (4.6–4.9s) and returns to 0 within 0.13s; pull-back 6.03x to 1x with no tilt at the start, a tilt that grows to -2° (Y) and 1° (X) as it pulls back and stays (perspective 2600px), then a slow drift 1.00 to 1.02 over 8.0–8.9s with the Y tilt easing to -1.4°

The bubble is 277×74px in the chat window with 15px type, violet, 20px corners and a 6px bottom-right corner. Its close-up is a separate element at screen size, 1,671×446px with 91px type and 121px and 36px corners (the same shape times 6.03), so the text stays sharp and the bubble keeps at least 120px to each frame edge. It opens from the squeezed bar, 14px wide and 446px tall and centered on x=960, widening evenly to both sides over 5.05–5.75s while the corner radius grows with the width. On the first frame of the pull-back (6.3s) the bubble inside the chat window, scaled 6.03x, takes over at the same size and position. The chat window is 1640×900px with an 11-conversation sidebar, 5 earlier messages, the summary bubble, Liam's reply and a composer with a Gist button; after the pull-back to 1x the bubble lands in the lower right of the window

says: A sentence too long to finish scrolls faster and faster
The last letter is stretched into giant shapes

zh.why: 滚动用三次方缓入，起步几乎静止，前两秒还能读出开头的字，之后加速到约 8200px/s，横向模糊随速度增大，观众先读到开头，随后文字快到读不完，最后感到这段话太长。句尾的 m 被拖长，用推近把重复的字形放大到每个 m 约占画面高度的 41%，这是整支片子的节拍点。压缩和展开发生在同一个位置：推近到位的画面压成一条竖线，竖线的宽度、高度和颜色与气泡的起始细条一致，气泡从这条线向左右两侧均匀展开，视线不用移动。结果和原文并置：底部聆听条里的计数器停在 36 words，气泡下方写着 36 words to 10，两个数字直接对比输入和输出的长度。全片只用一个强调色（紫色 #5b3df5），气泡、麦克风、计数徽标和标志共用它。
spec: 滚动 power2.in（三次方缓入），刹车和气泡展开 expo.out，推近和拉远用对数缩放（按 scale 的对数插值，输出 outQuart 和 outQuint），压缩 power3.inOut，摘要逐词 expo.out

聊天窗口里的短消息气泡 277×74px，15px 字，紫色底，圆角 20px，右下角 6px。特写里的气泡是一个按屏幕尺寸单独做的元素，1,671×446px，字 91px，圆角 121px、右下 36px（同样的形状乘以 6.03），所以文字保持清晰，左右各留至少 120px 边距。它从压缩出的竖条（约 14px 宽、446px 高，以 x=960 为中线）向两侧均匀展开，5.05–5.75s，圆角随宽度增大。拉远的第一帧（6.3s），聊天窗口里放大 6.03 倍的气泡以同样的大小和位置接替。聊天窗口 1640×900px，有 11 个会话的侧栏、5 条较早消息、摘要气泡和 Liam 的回复、带 Gist 按钮的输入框；镜头拉远到 1 倍后气泡落在窗口右下区

en.title: Scrolling Text Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A long run-on line scrolls faster and faster, then squeezes into one short chat bubble. Build it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
en.lede: One dictated line scrolls sideways from slow to fast, the last m is held and zoomed into giant humps, then the whole line squeezes into a bar and blooms into a two-line message bubble while the camera pulls back to the chat window around it.
en.name: Scrolling Text Animation

body.h2: How to make a Scrolling Text Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Set one 120px line of text (Inter 500, letter-spacing -0.035em, 36 words, 9,833px wide) at x=160 and scroll it left from 0.1 to 3.2s with power2.in, so it starts almost still and reaches about 8,200 px/s. Add horizontal blur with an SVG feGaussianBlur that grows from 0 to 36px with speed, then brake with expo.out over 0.5s so "um" rests at x=930, next to frame center.

Hold the last letter: 26 extra m appear between 3.3 and 4.1s, and the camera zooms 6.8x into them from 3.45 to 4.4s, so each m is about 446px tall. At 4.6s squeeze the zoomed frame into a bar about 14px wide over 0.45s (scaleX 1 to 0.0075, power3.inOut) while it turns violet, then open a violet bubble from the same bar, centered on x=960, from 5.05 to 5.75s with expo.out. Build the close-up bubble as its own element at screen size so the text stays sharp. The 10 summary words rise in one by one, 65ms apart.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the scroll, the squeeze and the 1.7s pull-back to the chat window. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: Huge black letters running off both edges of a white screen, above a Listening bar counting 36 words.
faq: How do you make a scrolling text animation that speeds up?

Put the whole sentence in one nowrap line and translate it left with power2.in, a cubic ease-in, so the speed starts near 0. Here the line travels about 8,500px in 3.1s and ends near 8,200 px/s. Link a horizontal blur to the speed so fast text smears into streaks.
How does the long line turn into one short message?

The line squeezes to a bar at frame center in 0.45s and a bubble of the same height replaces it on the same frame. The bubble blooms in 0.7s and the summary words rise in one after another, so the eye stays on one spot.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做滚动文字动画
body.body:
用一行 120px 的文字（Inter 500，字距 -0.035em，36 词，宽 9833px），起点 x=160，在 0.1 到 3.2s 用 power2.in 向左滚动，起步几乎静止，末速约 8200px/s。用 SVG feGaussianBlur 加横向模糊，stdDeviation 随速度从 0 增到 36px，之后用 expo.out 在 0.5s 内刹车，让“um”停在 x=930，靠近画面中心。

句尾的字母被按住：3.3 到 4.1s 追加 26 个 m，3.45 到 4.4s 镜头推近 6.8 倍，每个 m 约 446px 高。4.6s 用 0.45s 把推近到位的画面压成约 14px 宽的竖线（scaleX 1 到 0.0075，power3.inOut），同时字色变成紫色；5.05 到 5.75s 紫色气泡从这条线、以 x=960 为中线用 expo.out 向两侧展开。特写里的气泡单独做成按屏幕尺寸的元素，文字才保持清晰。10 词摘要逐词升入，间隔 65ms。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会做出滚动、压缩和 1.7s 拉远到聊天窗口的整个镜头。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 白色画面上的巨大黑字从两侧溢出，下方是显示 36 个词的收听条。
faq: 怎么做一段越滚越快的滚动文字动画？
把整句话放进一行不换行的文本，用 power2.in（三次方缓入）向左平移，速度从接近 0 开始。这支片子里整行在 3.1s 内移动约 8500px，末速约 8200px/s。让横向模糊跟着速度走，快的文字会被抹成一道横向的拖影。
长句怎么变成一条短消息？
整行在 0.45s 内压成画面中心的竖线，同一帧换成同样高度的气泡。气泡 0.7s 展开，摘要的词逐个升入，视线始终停在同一个位置。
